items.description: Vendor has confirmed the order and it is awaiting fulfilment processing.
Courier has collected the order from the vendor and is transporting it to the next processing point.
Order has been scanned and received at the sorting center.
Direct dispatch from vendor to rider without passing through a distribution center. Intended for urgent deliveries.
Order is consolidated for next-day processing and routed through the distribution center before final delivery.
Order is consolidated with other same-day shipments and routed through the distribution center before final delivery.
Order has been received and checked into the distribution center.
Order is being transferred between distribution centers or logistics hubs.
Order has been assigned to a rider and is awaiting delivery dispatch.
Rider has departed with the order and delivery is in progress.
Order has been successfully delivered to the customer.
Delivery has been rescheduled due to customer request, rider availability, or operational reasons.
Second delivery attempt was unsuccessful.
Third delivery attempt was unsuccessful and further action is required.
Order has been reassigned to a different rider or delivery resource.
Order reversal initiated by the DC.
Returned order is in transit back to the sorting center.
Returned order has been received at sorting and awaits handover to the vendor.
Returned order has been handed to the vendor and awaits acceptance.
Payment is required before the order can be completed or closed.
Required payment has been received and verified successfully.
Payment attempt failed, was rejected, or could not be verified.
Payment requirement has been waived according to business rules.
Vendor accepted the return and the return lifecycle is complete.
Vendor return has been declined and is closed.
Shipment marked as lost; retained in the lost report after payment completion.
